findings.title: stdout_tail / stderr_tail not redacted before write to tasks.json and cache.json (NFR-04)
findings.description: SPEC §4 NFR-04 (line 211-214) requires stdout_tail, stderr_tail, and audit-log `detail` to be redacted BEFORE write to disk using the regex `(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}|token=\S+|Bearer\s+\S+)`. The production paths `commands._persist_result` and `commands.run` -> `cache_record` pass these fields through unchanged.
findings.reasoning: Confirmed via grep that audit._redact is only invoked from audit.append_event (audit.py:161) and never from the commands.py write paths. The NFR-04 unit test (test_nfr04_secret_is_redacted_from_task_results) only exercises the _redact function in isolation on a hand-built dict; it does NOT drive the production write path. A task that echoes `sk-ABCD...` writes the secret verbatim to tasks.json AND cache.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap stdout_tail and stderr_tail with audit._redact in _persist_result, the cache-hit branch (line 480), and cache_record (line 513).
findings.verify_evidence: grep -n _redact src/.../commands.py src/.../task_store.py src/.../cache.py returns no matches; only audit.py uses _redact. SPEC §4 NFR-04 line 211-214 names exactly stdout_tail/stderr_tail/audit detail.

findings.title: plugins.append_audit_event bypasses audit._redact, leaking secrets into audit.jsonl (NFR-04)
findings.description: `service/plugins.py:99-125 append_audit_event` serialises the event payload directly with json.dumps and writes it to audit.jsonl without applying audit._redact. A plugin whose exception message contains `sk-...` / `token=...` / `Bearer ...` lands on disk unredacted, violating NFR-04.
findings.code_snippet:
payload = json.dumps(event, default=str) + "\n"
with _AUDIT_LOCK:
    fd = os.open(...)
findings.reasoning: Verified: the only call to audit._redact lives in audit.append_event:161. plugins.append_audit_event has its own json.dumps + os.open path that skips the redaction. A `detail.error` string from a plugin exception that contains `token=...` reaches the file verbatim.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply audit._redact to every value of the event dict before json.dumps. Import lazily so service does not depend on observability at module load time (SAB rule).
findings.verify_evidence: plugins.py:114 json.dumps(event, default=str) — no _redact call before this line; audit.py:130 _REDACTION_RE.sub — only invoked from audit._redact at audit.py:161.
